$f=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'v2.3.0rc3_check'; $r=Join-Path $f 'v2.3.0rc3_results.txt'; $n='Garmin Running Data Normalizer.lnk'; $v="$HOME\garmin-normalizer-rc\Scripts\python.exe"; $dl=(New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application).NameSpace('shell:Downloads').Self.Path; if (-not $dl) { $dl="$HOME\Downloads" }; Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $f 'synthetic_garmin_export_x12d.zip') -Destination $dl; $o=('W3 ' + (Get-Date -Format 'HH:mm') + ' / app ' + ((& $v -m garmin_running_data_normalizer --version) -replace '^.* ','') + ' / python ' + (& $v -c "import platform; print(platform.python_version())") + ' / tzdata ' + (((& $v -m pip show --disable-pip-version-check tzdata) -match '^Version:') -replace '^Version: ','') + ' / installed ' + ((& $v -m pip list --disable-pip-version-check --format=freeze --exclude pip) -join ' ') + ' / desktop-icon ' + (Test-Path (Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop')) $n)) + ' / start-icon ' + (Test-Path (Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Programs')) $n)) + ' / backend ' + [bool](Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'python.exe' OR Name = 'pythonw.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*garmin_running_data_normalizer*' }) + ' / zip-in-downloads ' + (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dl 'synthetic_garmin_export_x12d.zip'))); Add-Content -LiteralPath $r -Value $o -Encoding ASCII; $o
